sends.name: a first launch: one new connection, then reuse; the model ready after 41.5 s
the first host refuses the connection: the move is on the host left; day_first once per route
a 304 is taken; a 429 and a refusal end the request on their host (no move)
a standby's 503 on /v1/events: the next host, counted as a move
the bounds: a 13th (host, route) and a 5th (to, why) are not counted
two sends in a day, then midnight: day_first again on the new day
a platform that cannot tell the version or the connection counts neither
a new connection without its connect time: new_conn only
an idle install: a delta holding only its events posts is not sent; they wait for one with other content
the waiting events counts go with the next delta that has other content (a launch, a session, hosts)
a failed events post is sent at the next send point (a standby's 503 included)
midnight: events counts still waiting are dropped, never sent alone
ready is content: events counts beside it are sent
flags.analytics false: nothing counted, nothing sealed
